description: This PHP source file defines an acceptance testing class 'OpportunitiesCest' that automates UI tests for the Opportunities module in SuiteCRM. It includes setup for fake data generation, and test scenarios for viewing the module, creating opportunities, and cleaning up test data by deleting created records.

classes.name: OpportunitiesCest
classes.description: Acceptance testing class for the Opportunities module in SuiteCRM, includes setup and test scenarios for viewing, creating, and deleting opportunities, driven by Faker data and various acceptance step helpers.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes Faker generator and seeds fake data.

methods.name: testScenarioViewOpportunitiesModule
methods.description: Test scenario to verify the Opportunities module page loads and displays correctly.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateOpportunity
methods.description: Test scenario to create and delete an opportunity, including account creation and cleanup.
